# ConfDrive

> Open-source configuration management API and TypeScript SDK for application developers.

ConfDrive lets an application read project and folder settings from a self-hosted API. Its SDK provides local caching and cache validation. The repository contains an Express backend and an Angular management interface; no production API or hosting provider is supplied.

## Current status

- The public npm package is `@conf-drive/sdk`, but it has not yet been published. Check https://www.npmjs.com/package/@conf-drive/sdk.
- To use the SDK after publication, install it with `npm install @conf-drive/sdk`. The consuming application requires Node.js 18 or newer.
- The SDK requires a running ConfDrive API, project or folder settings, and an API secret. The backend currently persists data in local JSON files.
- The SDK sends its API secret in the `X-API-Secret` request header. Do not expose privileged credentials in a public browser bundle or commit credentials.
- Only the SDK is configured for public npm releases; the server and root monorepo are not npm packages.

## Confirmed SDK capabilities

- Read project keys and folder keys from the ConfDrive API.
- Cache settings locally and validate or refresh cached data.
- Subscribe to SDK events such as `cache:update`.

## Repository development

Repository development uses Node.js 22 or newer and npm. Run `npm test --workspace=@conf-drive/sdk` from the repository root to build and test the SDK.
